name: whisper-code
description: Real-time voice dictation for VS Code, powered by a self-hosted whisper-flow server.

whisperCode.serverUrl.markdownDescription: URL of the [whisper-flow](https://github.com/dimastatz/whisper-flow) server. The WebSocket URL is derived from it (`http` → `ws`, `https` → `wss`, plus `/ws`). Audio is sent only to this server; a non-local server needs your confirmation once.

whisperCode.model.markdownDescription: Model for each session, from the server's `GET /ready` `models` list (for example `base.en.pt`). Empty uses the server's default. Needs whisper-flow 1.2 or newer.

whisperCode.vocabulary.enabled.markdownDescription: Bias transcription toward identifiers from open editors (such as `useMemo` or `getUserById`), and respell them in the inserted text. Sending the vocabulary to the server needs whisper-flow 1.2 or newer.

whisperCode.recorderCommand.markdownDescription: Command that records the microphone and writes raw 16 kHz mono signed 16-bit little-endian PCM to stdout, for example `["sox", "-q", "-d", "-t", "raw", "-r", "16000", "-e", "signed-integer", "-b", "16", "-c", "1", "-L", "-"]`. Empty tries `sox`, then `arecord` (Linux) or `ffmpeg`.

whisperCode.wrap.comments.markdownDescription: Wrap dictated comments at this column, continuing with the comment marker (`// `, ` * `, `# `…). `0` turns wrapping off.

whisperCode.wrap.commitBody.markdownDescription: Wrap dictated commit message bodies at this column. The subject line is never wrapped. `0` turns wrapping off.

whisperCode.vocabulary.scanWorkspace.markdownDescription: Also collect identifiers from source files in the workspace that aren't open (skipping `node_modules`, build output and similar). Open editors always count more.

whisperCode.vocabulary.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Most workspace files to read for the vocabulary. Files over 200 KB are skipped, and scanning stops after 2 seconds.

scripts.test:coverage: vscode-test --coverage --coverage-reporter text --coverage-reporter json-summary --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-output coverage && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs 95
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
